# Test pe extract command - XML tag extraction from prompt outputs

# Basic XML tag extraction
exec sh -c 'pe run prompt.txt --provider mock | pe extract --tag answer'
stdout 'The capital of France is Paris'
! stdout '<answer>'
! stdout '</answer>'

# Extract multiple tags
exec sh -c 'pe run multi-output.txt --provider mock | pe extract --tags result,explanation'
stdout 'Result: 42'
stdout 'Explanation: The answer to life'

# Extract with specific tag
exec sh -c 'echo "<output><name>John</name><age>30</age></output>" | pe extract --tag name'
stdout 'John'
! stdout '<name>'

# Extract nested tags
exec sh -c 'pe run nested.txt --provider mock | pe extract --tag data --nested'
stdout '<item>First</item>'
stdout '<item>Second</item>'

# Extract with attribute filtering
exec sh -c 'pe run attributed.txt --provider mock | pe extract --tag response --attr type=final'
stdout 'This is the final answer'

# Extract to JSON format
exec sh -c 'pe run structured.txt --provider mock | pe extract --tag data -f json'
stdout '{'
stdout '"content":'
stdout '"metadata":'

# Extract with XPath-like selectors
exec sh -c 'pe run complex.txt --provider mock | pe extract --xpath "//answer[@confidence=\"high\"]"'
stdout 'Definitely Paris'

# Extract multiple occurrences
exec sh -c 'pe run listing.txt --provider mock | pe extract --tag item --all'
stdout 'Apple'
stdout 'Banana'
stdout 'Cherry'

# Extract with transformation
exec sh -c 'pe run formatted.txt --provider mock | pe extract --tag code --transform "pe fmt -"'
stdout 'func main() {'
stdout '    fmt.Println("Hello")'
stdout '}'

# Extract and validate
exec sh -c 'pe run validated.txt --provider mock | pe extract --tag solution --validate schema.json'
stdout 'Valid solution extracted'

# Extract with custom delimiters
exec sh -c 'pe run custom.txt --provider mock | pe extract --start "[[RESULT]]" --end "[[/RESULT]]"'
stdout 'Custom delimited content'

# Pipeline with extraction
exec sh -c 'pe run prompt.txt --provider mock | pe extract --tag answer | pe test --inline assertions.yaml'
stdout 'Test passed'

# Extract with error handling
! exec sh -c 'pe run invalid.txt --provider mock | pe extract --tag missing'
stderr 'No tag found: missing'

# Extract and save to file
exec sh -c 'pe run prompt.txt --provider mock | pe extract --tag response --output response.txt'
exists response.txt
exec grep 'Extracted content' response.txt

# Extract with streaming
exec sh -c 'pe run stream-prompt.txt --provider mock --stream | pe extract --tag chunk --stream'
stdout 'Chunk 1'
stdout 'Chunk 2'
stdout 'Chunk 3'

-- prompt.txt --
What is the capital of France?
<answer>The capital of France is Paris</answer>

-- multi-output.txt --
Calculate the meaning of life.
<result>42</result>
<explanation>The answer to life, the universe, and everything</explanation>

-- nested.txt --
List some items.
<data>
  <item>First</item>
  <item>Second</item>
</data>

-- attributed.txt --
Provide analysis.
<response type="preliminary">Initial thoughts</response>
<response type="final">This is the final answer</response>

-- structured.txt --
Generate data.
<data>
  <content>Main content here</content>
  <metadata>
    <author>AI Assistant</author>
    <timestamp>2024-01-20</timestamp>
  </metadata>
</data>

-- complex.txt --
What is the capital?
<answer confidence="low">Maybe London?</answer>
<answer confidence="high">Definitely Paris</answer>

-- listing.txt --
List fruits.
<item>Apple</item>
<item>Banana</item>
<item>Cherry</item>

-- formatted.txt --
Write Go code.
<code>
func main() {
fmt.Println("Hello")
}
</code>

-- validated.txt --
Solve the problem.
<solution>{"x": 5, "y": 10}</solution>

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "x": {"type": "number"},
    "y": {"type": "number"}
  }
}

-- custom.txt --
Process this.
[[RESULT]]Custom delimited content[[/RESULT]]

-- assertions.yaml --
assert:
  - contains: "Paris"
  - not_contains: "<answer>"

-- invalid.txt --
No tags here, just plain text.

-- stream-prompt.txt --
Stream some chunks.
<chunk>Chunk 1</chunk>
<chunk>Chunk 2</chunk>
<chunk>Chunk 3</chunk>
